parsed.g: Identify which customer(s) has completed the second most number of orders in the entire history of the Magento store.
P_t: Navigated to the Magento Admin Orders page (SALES > Orders) at http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/sales/order/
Confirmed there are 308 total orders across 2 pages in the orders list
Opened the Filters panel on the Orders page at step 13
Identified that the orders list has a Status filter with a 'Complete' option available
R_t: Select 'Complete' from the Status filter dropdown
Apply the filter to show only completed orders
Count the number of completed orders per customer (Bill-to Name)
Identify the customer with the most completed orders
Identify the customer(s) with the second most completed orders

The Filters panel is NOT open in the ground-truth DOM — the page shows the orders table without an active filter panel.
